description.narrative:
Caritas Bangladesh has been supporting access to education for poor and hard to reach communities for over 36 years. In many areas, their education centers are the only schools available for children. Despite significant progress in numerous regions, in recent years many areas are at risk for closure of their education centers, due to lack of funding and lack of government contributions. Since the COVID pandemic, communities are facing high levels of poverty, with many unable to pay the school fee. There is an increased risk that without funding, the education centers will close and over 11,000 children in hard to reach areas will therefore have no access to education. Since 2019, Caritas Bangladesh have enabled 9 education centers to continue, however, there are 301 education centers still in need of funding and support. This is vital to ensure that schools remain open, teachers are paid, and families are supported.
This project supports the continuation of 301 education centers in the Chittagong Hill tracts, enabling over 11,300 students to continue education and 352 teachers to maintain employment. The project will cover the areas inhabited mainly by the ethnic communities, who live in extreme poverty and face discrimination in accessing education, food security, employment, health care.
